info.title: Product Library Open API
info.description: Existing MuseDAM API keys require explicit team-scoped API Key Collaborator access and fresh caller-key validation upstream. The current local role alone determines capabilities; no selectable operation allowlist remains. MuseDAM owns issuance and lifecycle; this API has no key-management or collaborator endpoints. JSON operations use the standard envelope; successful downloads and exports return attachments. All request bodies are capped at 1048576 bytes. Errors before attachment delivery use the shared Error envelope. No CORS/rate-limit contract, 429, bulk writes, multipart upload, webhooks or approval callbacks are provided by v1. Aborted lock conflicts return 503 write_conflict with Retry-After: 1; committed mutations whose response is unavailable return 409 mutation_response_unavailable with an explicit mutationOutcome. Send POST /api/muse/product-api with Authorization: Bearer <APIKEY>. The required service selects an operation; all business parameters are flat in the JSON body. Caller identity and team context come from the API key, not orgId or userId request fields. x-services preserves the exact response and authorization contract for each service; aggregate responses do not imply every service returns every status or representation.

post.description: Use the required service field to select one of the 31 services. Send all business parameters in the JSON body, not in a URL path or query string. Optional HTTP control headers apply only to the services listed in x-services. Successful downloads and exports return bytes or business-table rows rather than the JSON success envelope. See x-services for per-service permissions, roles, responses and control-header semantics.

listBrands.description: Returns public metadata ordered by sortOrder then id. Raw logo URLs are excluded.

createBrand.description: Creates a brand; duplicate names are allowed and code is generated by the server. See BrandCreate for logo host restrictions.

getBrand.description: Returns the specified brand’s public metadata and current strong ETag. Raw logo URLs are excluded.

updateBrand.description: Updates the provided metadata fields; omitted properties remain unchanged. No file upload or generic asset replacement.

deleteBrand.description: Deletes only a brand with no live categories or products. Returns 409 otherwise; never cascades into products.

listCategorys.description: Returns a flat live tree ordered by brandId, parentId, sortOrder and id. Optional brand filter; no implicit subtree expansion.

createCategory.description: Creates a live node in the specified brand. Parent must be live in the same brand/library. Max depth 10 and max 5000 live nodes per brand. Sibling names must be unique. The library default template is explicitly bound only when it has no brand bindings or includes this brand; otherwise creation succeeds without an explicit binding, preserving ancestor, brand, then library-default template resolution.

getCategory.description: Returns the specified nondeleted category and current strong ETag. A missing category or one outside the current library returns 404.

updateCategory.description: Updates or moves a node within its existing brand; brandId is immutable. Rejects cycles/depth/node limits and invalid sort index. Updates descendant paths atomically.

deleteCategory.description: Soft-deletes the entire category subtree only if no live products reference any descendant. Does not delete or demote products.

listTemplates.description: Returns live template metadata, bindings and ordered groups/fields, including preview-only configuration. Ordered by createdAt descending then id.

createTemplate.description: Creates a template and an immutable version. syncStrategy is optional and only newOnly is supported. Allows at most 200 fields and leaves existing products unchanged.

getTemplate.description: Returns the specified nondeleted template’s metadata, bindings, and groups/fields, including preview-only configuration. Groups and fields are ordered by sortOrder then id, ascending. The current strong ETag covers live fields, groups, bindings, and the default designation.

updateTemplate.description: Uses the shared browser batch operation. Supplied groups/fields are a complete replacement; omitted groups are preserved. Stable IDs and protected system/default fields are validated. Creates a new immutable version without migrating existing product pins or values; bindings/default changes affect future template resolution.

deleteTemplate.description: Soft-deletes the live template while retaining immutable versions used by existing products. Current library default requires an explicit replacement or null; default/system protections still apply. Removes bindings without rewriting existing product pins.

listProducts.description: Ordinary pagination orders updatedAt/id descending. sync=true uses ascending (updatedAt,id), inclusive lower and exclusive fixed upper bound (PostgreSQL clock minus 30 seconds). A full scan omits updatedAfter; continue every nextCursor, even with an empty data page. Cursor binds key/role/library/filters/pageSize/bounds. Save syncedUntil verbatim only after exhaustion; replay/deduplicate by id and updatedAt. Transactions longer than the 30-second safety window are an accepted v1 limitation. view_only/usable see only published products.

createProduct.description: Creates draft only. Resolves and pins a template version at creation; template fields validate against that immutable definition. Attach existing same-library FilePath IDs; no upload, remote import or provider write-back. Idempotent replay preserves original scalar result/ETag and reprojects only original media still valid in the same current slot under current grants.

getProduct.summary: Read a product and its pinned definition
getProduct.description: Returns an accessible live product with its pinned immutable template definition, even after the live template changes or is deleted. Does not require templates:read. Media preview/download is authorized on every response; download requires products:read plus products:download and role usable or higher. Drafts are invisible to view_only/usable.

updateProduct.description: Merges scalar/custom fields and replaces submitted media lists. Uses the immutable pinned definition, including when the live template is deleted. Published products additionally require products:publish and stay published; full resulting-state validation must pass atomically. Status/template switching is not accepted here.

deleteProduct.description: Soft-deletes a visible live product. Draft requires delete; published requires delete and publish. Leaves historical template versions intact. No provider synchronization. A repeated delete returns 404.

setProductStatus.summary: Publish or return a product to draft
setProductStatus.description: Always requires both update and publish grants. Publishing validates all pinned required/type/option/media rules; invalid state returns 422 with field details and makes no changes. Repeated published keeps publishedAt, returning to draft clears it. No approval workflow is started.

checkProductVisibility.description: Checks up to 100 known IDs under current key visibility. Keeps order and duplicates, accepts an empty array. not_visible does not distinguish deleted, missing, foreign-library and role-hidden items. Use periodically to remove stale local entries because sync has no deletion tombstones. This read operation has no Idempotency-Key or ETag.

listAssets.description: Lists live non-directory FilePath assets in the key library, ordered by id. Requires either products:create or products:update under editable/manage role, not products:read. Returns previews only, never original download fields. Use FilePath id in product writes; uploads are outside v1.

getAsset.description: Returns a live same-library FilePath with preview-only media metadata. Same create-or-update gate as listing. Returns an opaque strong ETag based on the FilePath and linked AssetObject identities and maintained update timestamps; temporary signature changes do not change this tag.

listProductShares.description: Lists records from every browser actor and API key in the current team, newest first by createdAt and id. Optional productId returns complete matching operations; omission selects all team records. Only productId, page and pageSize are accepted; unknown business parameters return 422. The current API key or creator never implicitly narrows the list. Requires manage plus products:history, without products:read.

createProductShare.description: Creates a fixed selection of published products with a 7/30/90-day or unlimited lifetime. accessCode is optional and exactly four digits. allowDownload additionally requires products:download. The recipient needs no login or API key; unpublished/deleted products disappear from the live share. Creator-key changes do not revoke the independent team share. Optional 24-hour idempotency reuses the same share.

revokeProductShare.description: Revokes any share in the current team. Requires manage and products:share, without products:read. Repeating a revocation returns the original revokedAt. Unknown or foreign-team IDs return 404. No ETag or If-Match is used.

listProductDownloads.description: Lists records from every browser actor and API key in the current team, newest first by createdAt and id. Optional productId returns complete matching operations; omission selects all team records. Only productId, page and pageSize are accepted; unknown business parameters return 422. The current API key or creator never implicitly narrows the list. Requires manage plus products:history, without products:read.

downloadProducts.description: Returns one original, a ZIP of selected originals, or an XLSX/CSV/JSON business-table export. Requires current read and download grants under usable or higher; usable sees published products only. Accepted operations are recorded before delivery. With includeAssetUrls true (default), main-image, related-asset and custom image/file cells are stringified JSON arrays of download request descriptors, including for one file; empty cells are the string '[]'. Each descriptor is exactly {url:'https://open.musedam.cc/api/muse/product-api',method:'POST',body:{service:'downloadProductAsset',id:<productId>,assetKey:<rawKey>}}. Descriptors contain no credentials or headers; execution adds the user's Authorization: Bearer <APIKEY> and Content-Type: application/json. Each accepted retrieval has its own business record. API exports generate no legacy /api/open/v1 URLs. Web/member/share exports are unchanged. Optional Idempotency-Key retains one record for 24 hours while each retry reauthorizes and transfers current content. Product reads, previews and legacy storage downloadUrl use are not recorded by this operation.

200.description: Attachment bytes, not a success envelope. JSON exports contain an array of localized business-table rows with string cell values. With includeAssetUrls true (default), media cell strings must be parsed separately as JSON arrays of download request descriptors, even for one file; empty cells contain '[]'. XLSX and CSV use the same media cell contract. See ProductDownloadCreate for the exact descriptor shape, localized labels and includeAssetUrls false behavior. A failure after streaming begins can terminate the body and mark the record failed; it cannot replace the committed response with a JSON error.

listProductDownloadAssets.description: Returns current candidate selection keys and downloadable availability under read and download authorization. No business download record is created, and no original or preview URLs are returned. Use service downloadProductAsset or downloadProducts to retrieve bytes.

downloadProductAsset.description: Fetches one current product original identified by a raw candidate key in assetKey (for example p40:a2, without URL encoding). Requires a Bearer header and current read/download authorization; the URL contains no API-key secret. Creates a business record before delivery. Optional 24-hour idempotency is scoped separately from downloadProducts, reuses the record, and still reauthorizes and transfers current bytes.

200.description: Attachment bytes, not a success envelope. JSON exports contain a localized array of business-table rows. A failure after streaming begins can terminate the body and mark the record failed; it cannot replace the committed response with a JSON error.

bearerAuth.description: Existing MuseDAM API key with an explicit team-scoped collaborator grant. Send Authorization: Bearer <key> over HTTPS. The assigned local role determines capabilities independently of the creator; every admitted request validates the caller key upstream. Removed or unadded keys have no access. Upstream unavailability fails closed.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional nonblank value without ASCII controls. Scoped to team, key and create operation for 24 hours. Same canonical payload replays 201 and original scalar result/ETag; changed payload gives 409. Product media is reprojected using current authorization and valid original same-slot associations. Applies to createBrand, createCategory and createTemplate/createProduct; createProductShare and the two download services have their own replay semantics detailed in x-services.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Optional strong quoted ETag, * or comma-separated candidate tags. Weak tags do not match. Stale mismatch gives 412 after row lock, without writes; omission uses last-writer-wins. Refetch current data before reconciling. No If-None-Match/304 support.

ShareIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
ShareIdempotencyKey.description: Optional nonblank value without ASCII controls, at most 255 characters. Scoped to team, API key and share creation for 24 hours. Matching input reuses the share; changed input returns 409. No header or expired retention creates a new operation. Current authorization is checked on replay.

DownloadIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
DownloadIdempotencyKey.description: Optional nonblank value without ASCII controls, at most 255 characters. Scoped to team, API key and download operation for 24 hours. Matching input reuses the business record but reauthorizes, reads current content and transfers again; file bytes are not cached. downloadProducts and downloadProductAsset have separate operation scopes. Changed input returns 409. Omission, a new key or expiry creates a new record; deduplication is not permanent.

Cache-Control.description: Always private, no-store, including errors. Do not cache signed media or credentials.

X-Request-Id.description: Server-generated correlation ID; JSON envelopes also include requestId.

ETag.description: Strong opaque quoted resource validator; send verbatim in If-Match for a later mutation. It covers stored resource state, not expiring media URL text.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment filename. One original keeps its filename; multiple originals use products.zip; exports use products.xlsx, products.csv or products.json.

X-Download-Record-Id.description: Business record ID for this accepted operation; retries with the retained idempotency key reuse it. It does not certify delivery or local-save completion.

X-Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present with true only when the retained business record is reused.

syncedUntil.description: PostgreSQL clock minus 30 seconds, fixed for the cycle. Save this exact string only after nextCursor is null.

PublicAsset.description: Product media projection. id is FilePath.id, never AssetObject.id or ProductAsset.id. Download properties are omitted unless a current, resolvable product association is downloadable under products:read + products:download and role usable/editable/manage. An authorized unavailable original may return null. Non-image originals never serve as previews. Preview null means unavailable. For a finite key, stored third-party previews with unverifiable expiry return null. Keys without expiry retain eligible stored third-party previews; their lifetime is provider-controlled, without a service-issued TTL guarantee.

FieldConfig.description: Type-dependent configuration; media references in reads are projected to PreviewAsset, removing storage paths and credentials. System customPlaceholder may be at most 255 characters. System brand/category cannot accept custom options.

ProductCreate.description: Always creates draft. Explicit templateId must be a live same-library template and takes precedence. When templateId is omitted/null and a non-null categoryId is supplied, resolution follows category or ancestor binding, then that category's brand binding, then library default. When categoryId is omitted or null, only the library default is considered, even if brandId is supplied. If no template resolves, the product has no template. Category must match resulting brand; owner must be a same-team member and defaults to null, not key creator. At most 100 total references across cover/images/related/custom media. Image slots require images; custom media must satisfy pinned count/size/type limits.

ProductDownloadRecord.description: One accepted logical operation, with first-acceptance product/file labels and actor attribution retained. requested records acceptance, not completed transfer or client save. failed records a detected preparation or stream failure and is not reset by a later retry. A product filter retains the complete multi-product operation.

ProductDownloadCandidate.description: A current selection key and availability metadata. No original URL, signed URL or preview URL is exposed; availability does not guarantee future transfer.

ProductDownloadCreate.description: assets selects all originals when assetKeys is omitted, or only the supplied current keys. export rejects assetKeys and produces a localized business table. format, includeAssetUrls and locale apply only to exports; asset downloads accept but ignore them for delivery. With includeAssetUrls true (default), main-image, related-asset and custom image/file cells in XLSX/CSV/JSON are stringified JSON arrays, even for one file; empty cells are the string '[]'. Each descriptor is exactly {url:'https://open.musedam.cc/api/muse/product-api',method:'POST',body:{service:'downloadProductAsset',id:<productId>,assetKey:<rawKey>}}. assetKey is not URL-encoded. No credentials or headers are embedded; execution adds the user's Authorization: Bearer <APIKEY> and Content-Type: application/json. Media column labels, including custom labels, use the localized ' (download requests)' suffix instead of URL labels. JSON exports remain arrays of localized business rows with string cell values; parse each media cell separately. Ordinary fields are unchanged. With includeAssetUrls false, main-image and related-asset cells are empty strings and custom image/file cells retain semicolon-separated file names. locale changes system labels/status and the suffix, not user-authored labels or values. API exports generate no legacy /api/open/v1 URLs; web/member/share exports are unchanged.
